snippet.title: Super 100 News: Rampur CRPF Camp Blast Accused News | Nisha Bhagat Case Update | UP Politics
snippet.description:
Super 100 News: Rampur CRPF Camp Blast Accused News | Nisha Bhagat Case Update | UP Politics

यूपी के रामपुर में CRPF कैंप पर हमले के आरोपी की गोली मारकर हत्या... अज्ञात हमलावरों ने मोहम्मद शरीफ़ को गोली मारी... 7 साल की सज़ा काटकर एक साल पहले ही जेल से बाहर आया था, 31 अक्टूबर 2007 में हुई थी सीआरपीएफ कैंप पर हुआ था हमला

सीबीआई को सौंपी गई झारखंड की आदिवासी कार्यकर्ता निशा भगत की मौत की जांच... सीएम हेमंत सोरेन ने की थी सिफारिश... निशा ने 6 नवंबर को रांची के अपने घर में फेसबुक लाइव के बाद की थी खुदकुशी...सरकार, ज़मीन के दलालों और पुलिस-प्रशासन पर लगाया था आरोप

यूपी में विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले ओवैसी और चंद्रशेखर आज़ाद के बीच गठबंधन के लिए बनी सहमति.. सूत्रों के मुताबिक 12 नवंबर को हो सकता है औपचारिक एलान... और भी दलों से गठबंधन में लाने की कोशिशें जारी


यूपी में आज युवाओं और किसानों को बड़ी सौगात देंगे सीएम योगी... 1 हज़ार से ज्यादा जूनियर सहायकों को सौंपेंगे नियुक्ति पत्र.. 4 हज़ार 300 किसानों को 215 करोड़ रुपये की सहायता राशि भी करेंगे वितरित



The accused in the attack on the CRPF camp in Rampur, Uttar Pradesh, was shot dead... Unknown assailants shot Mohammad Sharif... He had been released from jail just a year earlier after serving a 7-year sentence; the CRPF camp was attacked on October 31, 2007.

The CBI has been entrusted with the investigation into the death of Jharkhand tribal activist Nisha Bhagat... CM Hemant Soren had recommended it... Nisha committed suicide on November 6th at her home in Ranchi after a Facebook Live... She had blamed the government, land brokers, and the police administration.

Agreement has been reached between Owaisi and Chandrashekhar Azad for an alliance before the UP assembly elections. Sources indicate a formal announcement is expected on November 12th... Efforts are underway to bring more parties into the alliance.

CM Yogi will give a major gift to youth and farmers in Uttar Pradesh today... He will hand out appointment letters to over 1,000 junior assistants... He will also distribute assistance of ₹215 crore to 4,300 farmers.

snippet.title: ASIC says it's 'fed up' with private credit sector's seeming indifference to cleaning up its act
snippet.description:
It is not for lack of trying, but ASIC is furious with the private credit sector's seeming indifference to the regulator's attempt to crack down on poor lending practices. The corporate cop's anger is understandable too. Private credit has issued hundreds of billions of dollars of funds, and its lending practices fuel property development and construction. Private credit refers to lending outside the banking sector. Central to ASIC's concerns is the opaque nature of the sector's finances. It means investors remain in the dark on the risks of private credit investments. "I am absolutely fed up, at ASIC we are absolutely fed up," ASIC commissioner Simone Constant said. ASIC has today released its second major surveillance of private credit in Australia. "We have drawn a line in the sand with a second comprehensive broad and deep surveillance report," Ms Constant said. "Many investors are still not being given the information they need to properly understand the risks, fees and conflicts present in private credit investments," ASIC found. The watchdog's second major surveillance report of the sector found "complex structures, opacity and deficient disclosure practices persist".

snippet.title: 히잡 쓰고 탕 안에 들어와 '찰칵찰칵'..경찰 출동까지, 무슨 일이? (자막뉴스) / SBS
snippet.description:
히잡을 쓴 여성들이 큰 소파에 앉아 있고, 출동 경찰이 이들을 상대로 뭔가를 묻고 있습니다.

부산 해운대에 있는 한 유명 찜질방에서 히잡을 쓴 외국인들이 탕 내부를 촬영해 경찰이 출동한 모습이라며 오늘(10일) SNS에 게재된 사진입니다.

글쓴이는 "찜질스파에 갔다가 경찰을 불렀다"며 "히잡 차림에다 선글라스를 쓴 외국인들이 탕 안에 들어오더니 사진을 찍기 시작했다"고 증언했습니다.

너무 놀란 나머지 급히 카운터로 뛰어갔다던 글쓴이는 직후 경찰을 불렀다고 전했습니다.

글쓴이는 찜질방 직원과 함께 외국인 4명을 로비에 앉힌 뒤, 경찰 출동을 기다리며 탕 안에서 찍은 사진을 보여줄 것과 삭제를 요청했는데 이들 가운데 한국말을 조금 할 줄 아는 외국인이 휴대전화를 검사하지 말 것을 요구했다고 언급했습니다.

그러면서 본인들은 사진을 찍지 않았다고 주장했으나, 경찰이 확인해 보니 탕 안 사진이 나왔다고 밝혔습니다.

글쓴이는 "기분이 불쾌하고 공포스러운 마음은 사그라들지 않았다"면서도 경찰이 자상하게 그렇게 하지 말라고 외국인들에게 말하자, 이들이 사건의 심각성을 모르는지 웃었다는 주장도 했습니다.

그러면서, 경찰관에게 상황의 심각성을 모르니, 외국인들에게 강력하게 말해달라고 요구했다고도 덧붙였습니다.

해당 SNS 게시물과 관련 뉴스엔 외국인들의 상식 밖 행동에 대한 비판과 경찰 대응을 두고 갑론을박이 이어지고 있습니다.

snippet.description:
Islam is one of the world’s major religions, followed by over a billion people across many countries. It began in the 7th century in the city of Mecca with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad. Muslims believe that he received revelations from God (Allah), which were later compiled into the holy book called the Qur'an.

Core Beliefs

Islam is strictly monotheistic, meaning Muslims believe in only one God, called Allah. The central concept is submission to the will of God, which is what the word “Islam” means.

Muslims follow six main beliefs:

Belief in one God (Allah)

Belief in angels

Belief in holy books (including the Qur'an, Torah, Psalms, and Gospel in their original forms)

Belief in prophets (such as Adam, Moses, and Jesus, with Muhammad as the final prophet)

Belief in the Day of Judgment

Belief in divine destiny (Qadar)


The Five Pillars of Islam

These are the main acts of worship that guide a Muslim’s daily life:

1. Shahada – Declaration of faith


2. Salat – Praying five times a day


3. Zakat – Giving charity to those in need


4. Sawm – Fasting during the holy month of Ramadan


5. Hajj – Pilgrimage to Mecca at least once if able



Holy Places

Kaaba – The most sacred site in Islam

Al-Masjid an-Nabawi – Mosque of the Prophet in Medina

Al-Aqsa Mosque – One of the oldest and most important mosques


Practices and Lifestyle

Islam provides guidance for daily life, including:

Halal and Haram (permitted and forbidden actions)

Modesty in behavior and dress

Respect for parents and elders

Honesty, charity, and kindness


Branches of Islam

The two main branches are:

Sunni Islam – The largest group

Shia Islam – The second largest group


Holy Days and Celebrations

Eid al-Fitr – Celebrates the end of Ramadan

Eid al-Adha – Commemorates the willingness of Prophet Abraham to sacrifice his son


Summary

Islam is a complete way of life that emphasizes faith in one God, moral conduct, compassion, justice, and community. Its teachings influence not only religious practices but also social, ethical, and personal behavior.
